title: Transfer and Compose Procedures Through Evidence-Linked Concept Graphs
target_platform: Local deterministic graph traverser; query_graph.py; disclose.py; cheap LLM synthesizer (ceiling 600k tokens)
hypothesis: Retrieval over typed concept relationships (preconditions, mechanisms, counterexamples, outcomes) followed by procedure synthesis will: (a) improve success on unseen composed tasks by >= 15 percentage points over the stronger of lexical retrieval and untyped graph traversal; (b) retain >= 95% accuracy on familiar control tasks; and (c) stay within an identical 6,000-token retrieval budget per task.
falsification_criteria: Fail if any threshold is missed, or if improvement depends on answer-bearing links inserted after seeing held-out tasks. Causality must not be inferred solely from a wikilink.
experiment: Build a frozen corpus from 30 validated procedures/concepts. Construct 60 held-out tasks requiring combinations of 2 or 3 mechanisms absent as complete examples in the corpus. Match model, tools, context budget, and task order. Ablate edge types to determine whether typed semantics add value beyond connectivity.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Frontier models are excluded; graph algorithms are deterministic Python and procedure synthesis is bounded cheap tier.

related_missions.MISSION-010: EXTENDS: applies causal reasoning mechanisms to active procedure graph traversal.
related_missions.MISSION-012: EXTENDS: combines graph topology with aggressive token retrieval compression.
related_missions.MISSION-042: SUPPLIES DATA TO: feeds synthesized multi-step plans into the local FSM procedure executor.

resources: fixture knowledge graph, max 600k inference tokens
